biography_english:
A Bakram who was once a sibyl of the Order of Philaha. She is the daughter of Archiereus Mreuva. After escaping political strife in Heim, she continued to pass on the teachings of the Order with her father. She joined the upper echelons of the Order upon her father's disappearance, and her stoutness of heart garnered much trust from the congregation.
  She came upon Abuna Prancet while traveling the Corpsevale on the outskirts of Heim, and took the ailing abuna to Brigantys Castle. When {hero} came to the castle she arranged for them to meet, and later told him of his lineage.
  She then joined the Resistance in the hopes that it would lead her to her own father.
biography_spanish:
Una bakram que fue sacerdotisa de la Orden de Philaha. Es hija del Arcipreste Mreuva. Tras huir de la lucha politica en Heim, continuo difundiendo las doctrinas de la Orden con su padre. Se sumo a la alta c{bFA}pula de la Orden tras la desaparicion de su padre, y su gran entereza de corazon le valio mucha confianza de toda la congregacion.               
  Encontro al abuna Prancet mientras viajaba por Corpsevale, en las afueras de Heim, y llevo al enfermo abuna al Castillo de Brigantys. Cuando {hero} llego al castillo, facilito su encuentro y mas tarde le revelo su linaje.       
  Se unio a la Resistencia para intentar dar con el paradero de su padre.

biography_english:
A Xenobian of unknown origin who once served with the Mages Regiment of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  She was a principal architect of the kingdom's establishment. Her thirst for arcane knowledge is boundless, and she has come to Valeria to gather funds to further her studies.
  She is also remarkably fond of pumpkins.
biography_spanish:
Una xenobiana de origen desconocido que sirvio en el Regimiento Magico del Reino de Nueva Xenobia. 
  Fue pieza clave al fundar el reino. Su sed de conocimiento arcano es insaciable y vino a Valeria a juntar fondos para continuar sus estudios.                                 .
  Siente una gran devocion por calabazas.

biography_english:
A Xenobian from Peshaval who once led the Beast Regiment of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  He is a close friend of Canopus. When Xenobia fell under the rule of the Sacred Xytegenian Empire, he bent to their will at first, reluctant to bring war upon his people. However, convinced by Canopus to take action, he joined the rebel movement and led an uprising against the occupying forces. Iuria, sister to Canopus, also considers him a trusted friend.
  After the Kingdom of New Xenobia was established, he traveled to the Holy Lodissian Empire.
biography_spanish:
Un xenobiano de Peshaval que lidero el Regimiento de Bestias de Nueva Xenobia.         
  Es un gran amigo de Canopus. Cuando Xenobia cayo bajo el Sagrado Imperio de Xytegenia, al principio cedio ante ellos por temor a traer la guerra a su pueblo. Sin embargo, persuadido por Canopus, se unio a la rebelion y lidero un alzamiento contra los ocupantes. Iuria, la hermana de Canopus, tambien lo considera un amigo de confianza.                       
  Tras la fundacion de Nueva Xenobia, viajo al Sagrado Imperio de Lodis.

biography_english: A Loslorien commander from Niemaran, a small town in the borderlands of Lodis. He is last born of the former Nildahme royal house, which once wielded great power throughout the Sea of Lhai region. He prefers hand-to-hand combat to swordplay, and is a masterful strategist. He was ordered by Lanselot Tartaros to locate a woman named Mannaflora, who had borne the child of King Dorgalua.
biography_spanish: Comandante de Loslorien de Niemaran, un poblado de la frontera de Lodis. Es el menor de la antigua casa real de Nildahme, que domino el mar de Lhai. Prefiere el combate cuerpo a cuerpo antes que la espada, y es un gran estratega. Lanselot Tartaros le ordeno ubicar a Mannaflora, quien tuvo una hija del rey Dorgalua.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Niemaran, a small town in the borderlands of Lodis. He is of Bolmoccan descent.
  He is last born of the former Nildahme royal house, which once wielded great power throughout the Sea of Lhai region. The Holy Lodissian Empire saw the bountiful lands of the Kingdom of Nildahme as ripe for the taking. They staged an uprising among the enslaved masses from which the ruling house had fattened their purse, then sent in their armies. Fearing for his life, the King hastily abandoned all resistance, and yielded to the Lodissians. Since then the Bolmoccans have endured lives of servitude.
  Andoras fled from a skirmish with Resistance forces while on a covert assignment.
biography_spanish:
Candante de Loslorien de Niemaran, un pueblo fronterizo de Lodis. Es de ascendencia bolmocca.           
  Es el menor de la antigua casa real de Nildahme, que domino la region del mar de Lhai. El Sagrado Imperio de Lodis vio las ricas tierras de Nildahme listas para tomar. Incitaron un alzamiento de los esclavos de los que la casa real se enriquecia y enviaron sus ejercitos. El rey rindio todo por temor. Desde entonces, los bolmoccas viven en la servidumbre.                                                                                                                                                    
  Andoras huyo de la Resistencia tras un combate en una mision secreta.

biography_english: A Bakram warrior with the Liberation Front. He was a top recruit at the famed Vanaheimr Officer's Academy. War broke out soon after he was made a knight of the realm. He remained faithful to the royal line after the war came to an end, opposing Brantyn's rule. He joined the Liberation Front upon being driven from his knightly order.
biography_spanish: Guerrero bakram del Frente de Liberacion. Fue un recluta destacado en la academia militar de Vanaheimr. La guerra estallo al poco tiempo de ser nombrado caballero. Tras el fin del conflicto, siguio fiel a la linea real y se opuso a Brantyn. Al ser expulsado de la orden de caballeria, se unio al Frente de Liberacion.
